notes: §1985:VII.2.12.3 SR2: "The END OF REEL/UNIT phrase may only be used if file-name-2 is a sequentially organized file." FileControlBinder.IoControl#ScreenRerunClauses resolves file-name-2 of an EVERY [END OF] REEL/UNIT phrase (visible files, GLOBAL ones of a containing program included) and refuses with COBOL6529 unless IsSequentiallyOrganized (sequential and not an SD, kb/Work PB5312); the RECORDS phrase, which GR2 d lets name any organization, is not asked. Probes at 85: END OF UNIT OF relative, REEL OF indexed (with and without ON), END OF REEL OF an SD, and END OF REEL OF a GLOBAL relative file from a contained program refused (COBOL6529); END OF REEL/UNIT OF sequential files accepted and ran; 100 RECORDS OF relative and of indexed accepted; an undefined file-name-2 draws COBOL1639. Witness: END OF REEL OF a relative file refused.

next.reason: 1985: "The END OF REEL/UNIT phrase may only be used if file-name-2 is a sequentially organized file."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the RERUN clause; the REEL/UNIT candidates cover only the CLOSE, READ and WRITE statements.". No 2023 clause holds the RERUN feature. Candidates on REEL/UNIT concern CLOSE, READ and WRITE, not RERUN, so the 2023 standard lacks the clause and this rule.
